question_text: Gross profit is calculated as
explanation: Gross profit = Sales - Cost of goods sold.

explanation: Cost of goods sold = Opening stock + Purchases - Closing stock.

question_text: Net profit is calculated as
explanation: Net profit = Gross profit - Expenses.
